From: Lea Stone
To: Owen Pike
Date written: June 02, 1844
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10116
Lea Stone would send the northern field notebook only if
the permit arrived.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
